verdict.justification: Both deliverables correctly identify the discrepancy in the source files: the three items on the Daily Receiving Log have no matching entry in "Inv on line", while item P11-P09457-01 mentioned in the prompt is in "Inv on line" (location A-300-K02) but missing from the Daily Receiving Log. Deliverable A is much stronger as a usable Excel spreadsheet because it keeps C3 as an empty input cell and puts dynamic formulas in F3 (`=IF(C3="","",C3/2)`) and G3 (`=IF(C3="","",C3-F3)`), so the report automatically calculates as soon as the missing quantity is entered. In contrast, Deliverable B hardcodes text strings (`TBD - not on log`, `TBD (= half of qty rec'd)`, `TBD`) into numeric columns. Furthermore, Deliverable B leaks internal AI environment references in its Notes sheet (`The workspace/ and attachments/ folders were empty, so no operative-record registry or other records were available`), which is inappropriate in a professional deliverable. Deliverable A also includes a clean, well-structured Cross-Reference tab and an Exceptions/Assumptions tab.
